sentences: Algorithmic statistics seeks a simple probability distribution that plausibly explains an individual data string.
The source studies versions constrained by polynomial computation time and distinguishes acceptable, plausible, and optimal hypotheses.
The question asks whether some strings have no simple optimal hypothesis in this resource-bounded framework.
An optimal explanation must meet the paper's coding-based criterion, rather than merely pass the available statistical tests.
An example lacking such explanations would show that efficient statistical modeling can fail for intrinsic computational reasons, even when unrestricted descriptions offer a different picture.
